items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQzNjUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--bb898e29295b507be8f64213b666a4b0e2443fc3/Logo2025_menor.png) 🇧🇷 **Português:** Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoBrasileiro2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇬🇧 **English:** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoBrasileiro2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Missouri Championship 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODY4NzEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--97e4c33ee65ceb378f56ab80cdae1d4b7060b87c/MOC%202025.jpg) **This is a multi-site competition in Raymore, Missouri.** PBQ events (3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD, and FMC) will be held on July 18th at Centerview in Harrelson Hall A **(Address: 227 Municipal Cir, Raymore, MO)**. If you are not participating in these events, you are not required or obligated to attend this day, but you are welcome if you wish. All other events will be held on Saturday July 19th and Sunday July 20th at the Raymore Activity Center. The venues are both located in Raymore, about 2 miles apart. We have a local facebook group where we will be posting upcoming events as they are announced as well as supporting local cubing conversations for Missouri. Jump over and join the [Missouri Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1548283828980986) facebook group.
